summary:
Planeta 9: SPHEREx Motion Explorer is an interactive web platform designed to make NASA’s astronomical data accessible to everyone.

Using real observations from NASA’s SPHEREx mission, our platform allows users to explore how the sky changes over time by entering coordinates, selecting infrared detectors, and generating animations from images taken at different dates. It automatically retrieves, selects, and aligns astronomical data, eliminating the need for programming or specialized software.
Our project addresses a major challenge: SPHEREx produces enormous amounts of data that no single person can explore alone. By simplifying access to these observations, Planeta 9 opens new opportunities for education, scientific exploration, and citizen science.
Beyond visualization, our long-term vision is to support collaborative discoveries, automated tracking of moving objects, and future applications in planetary defense, astronomical research, and space resource exploration.
The universe is too vast to explore alone. Let’s explore it together!
details:
Planeta 9: SPHEREx Motion Explorer is a web platform that makes NASA’s astronomical data accessible to everyone, without requiring programming skills.

Using real SPHEREx observations from NASA/IPAC IRSA, users can enter sky coordinates, select infrared detectors, and generate animations to explore how the sky changes over time. The platform automatically retrieves, selects, and aligns astronomical images, providing visual comparisons and scientific information. It also includes an experimental tool for exploring asteroid observations.

Developed with Python, Streamlit, Astropy, Astroquery, and Reproject, our prototype transforms complex astronomical data into an interactive experience.

Our goal is to make astronomy more accessible and encourage citizen science, allowing students, enthusiasts, and volunteers to participate in exploring the enormous amount of data collected by space missions.

In the future, Planeta 9 could incorporate automated detection and tracking of moving objects, supporting planetary defense, astronomical research, and space resource exploration.

The universe is too vast to explore alone. Planeta 9 aims to make exploration a collective effort.
